description: Single polygon. Tests whether the layer can express a non-primitive outline at all.
prompt: On a 200x200 pixel canvas filled with black (#000000), draw a filled yellow (#ffff00) triangle with vertices at (100, 30), (170, 160) and (30, 160). Coordinates are in pixels measured from the top-left corner of the canvas, with x increasing to the right and y increasing downwards.
